title: Graphene monolayer — 2d materials
description: This is a Signature-authored nanomaterial study. The graphene monolayer is a 2D nanomaterial with tensile strength: 130 GPa intrinsic; optical absorption: 2.3% of visible light (nearly transparent). Fabrication route: chemical vapor deposition. The nanoscale runs 1–100 nm; a nanometer is a billionth of a meter — about 100,000 times smaller than a human hair’s width.
